channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Politicians slam Trump’s suggestion that Iran ‘take’ San Diego, Los Angeles
item.description: Both Democrats and Republicans have expressed outrage at Trump's remarks that cities could be sacrificed in Iran war.

item.title: Yemeni forces launch offensive to retake Houthi-held al-Waziiya in Taiz
item.description: The mountainous district is key to control of Mocha, the Red Sea port the Houthis seized last month.

item.title: Sudan’s al-Burhan rejects talks, vows to retake all territory from RSF
item.description: At least 10 civilians were killed in West Kordofan and 5,500 displaced in Blue Nile as clashes widened on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran war live: Yemen forces claim control over strategic Taiz mountain peak
item.description: Yemeni forces claim they have tightened control over the highest peak in the Jabal Habashi district of Taiz.

item.title: Houthis, Saudi-led forces claim victories as Yemen fighting rages on
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Jazan and Najran airports were attacked as Saudi-led gov’t forces launched air strikes on the Houthis.

item.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
item.description: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.

item.title: Nigeria mourns 25 killed as military plane crashes into swamp
item.description: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.

item.title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
item.description: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.
